The '''''Journal of Recreational Mathematics''''' was an American journal dedicated to [[recreational mathematics]], started in 1968.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last=Trigg|first=Charles W.|author-link=Charles W. Trigg|date=1978|title=What Is Recreational Mathematics?|url=http://www.jstor.org/stable/2689642|journal=[[Mathematics Magazine]]|volume=51|issue=1|pages=18–21|doi=10.2307/2689642|jstor=2689642|issn=0025-570X}}</ref> It had generally been published quarterly by the Baywood Publishing Company, until it ceased publication with the last issue (volume 38, number 2) published in 2014.  The initial publisher (of volumes 1–5) was [[Greenwood Periodicals]].

[[Harry L. Nelson]] was primary editor for five years<ref>{{Cite web|title=Fonds F0158 - Harry L. Nelson fonds.|url=https://searcharchives.ucalgary.ca/harry-l-nelson-fonds|access-date=2024-03-02|website=[[University of Calgary]]}}</ref> (volumes 9 through 13, excepting volume 13, number 4, when the initial editor returned as lead) and [[Joseph Madachy]], the initial lead editor and editor of a predecessor called ''Recreational Mathematics Magazine'' which ran during the years 1961 to 1964,<ref name=":0" /> was the editor for many years.  [[Charles Ashbacher]] and Colin Singleton took over as editors when Madachy retired (volume 30 number 1).  The final editors were Ashbacher and Lamarr Widmer.  The journal has from its inception also listed associate editors, one of whom was [[Leo Moser]].

The journal contains:
# Original articles
# [[Book review]]s
# [[Verbal arithmetic|Alphametic]]s And Solutions To Alphametics
# [[Mathematical problem|Problems]] And [[Conjecture]]s
# Solutions To Problems And Conjectures
# Proposer's And Solver's List For Problems And Conjectures
